description: You're a night-shift worker whose schedule has shifted: you now wake up at 6:00 AM instead of the f.lux default 8:00 AM. f.lux uses this 'wake time' to decide when to ramp the screen color back to daytime values. Change f.lux's wake-time setting from 8:00 AM to 6:00 AM. f.lux stores this in `~/Library/Preferences/org.herf.Flux.plist` under the key `wakeTime` as minutes-from-midnight, so the target value is 360 (= 6 × 60). You can change it through f.lux's Preferences window (the time-stepper labeled 'is when I wake up', below the day/night curve graph), via `defaults write org.herf.Flux wakeTime -int 360`, or by editing the plist directly with PlistBuddy — the verifier checks the final plist value, not the path you took. DO NOT alter unrelated preferences (location, Sparkle update settings); the verifier rejects shotgun edits.
natural_language: Change f.lux's wake-time setting from 8:00 AM to 6:00 AM. The setting lives in ~/Library/Preferences/org.herf.Flux.plist under key `wakeTime` (minutes from midnight; target value 360).
